attribution.attribution_reached: TCP-client global load at a 2 MiB-aligned unmapped page inside the faulting process; no kernel name, no solution

decision.why: the historical fault reproduces in the model reproducer with the same kernel-log signature (2 MiB-aligned page, TCP client, permission fault, no reset), but the faulting kernel and hipBLASLt solution stay unresolved. The single-GEMM form of the hypothesis is not supported on this build: the call whose descriptors match the archived 16E capture exactly is clean at 16-byte slack, and the faulting 8E run never dispatches that geometry. The rocBLAS arm is not a clean control because rocBLAS delegated its calls back to hipBLASLt kernels. The mechanism is not confirmed and no mitigation should be designed from this evidence.
